neighbours.label: the start of the corrected claim after a 'not X' clause ('it is not about X; it is about Y', 'don't need X, they need Y'); weak pole
fire: Success is not about money; it is about doing work you are proud of.
The city doesn't need more parking, it needs better buses.
This isn't a technical problem; it is a management problem.
Patients don't want sympathy, they want answers from their doctors.
The issue is not the price; the issue is the quality.
Our team doesn't lack talent, it lacks direction.
Love is not a feeling; it is a decision you make every day.
Students don't need more rules, they need more trust.
quiet: Success is about money, and it is about doing work you are proud of.
The city needs more parking and it needs better buses.
This is a technical problem that the engineers will fix soon.
Patients want answers and they want sympathy from their doctors.
The price is high and the quality is excellent.
Our team has talent and it has a clear direction.
Love is a feeling that grows stronger every day.
Students need clear rules and a quiet place to work.

notes: Card: 'don't need a teacher, they need a friend', 'not by that. In fact', 'What it means is'. Probe was weak: not about winning; 0.198, don't have a funding problem, we have 0.090, don't need homework, they 0.062; affirmative versions 0.007-0.013. Expect a weak or failed test.
